The Production-safe equivalent: re-publish every pre-existing Space under 0033 inside a transaction that rolls back, and check 0033's conditional keys are absent.
G_legacyEquivalence.attribution: Those added keys come from 0017/0020/0031/0032, which post-date those snapshots - not from 0033. A first naive comparison of 'stored snapshot' vs 're-publish now' showed all seven differing and was the wrong test: it conflates every publish_space change since each snapshot, plus any draft edit since, with this migration's effect.
